# Notice

This skill is an addition to copilot code review and is not a replacement for it. It is designed to help with code review tasks, but it does not have the same capabilities as copilot code review.

# Follow code guidelines

Make sure you read the code guidelines from copilot code review and follow them to per form the review.

# Mark new files

For new files, add a comment at the top of the file indicating that it is a new file. This will help reviewers understand that the file is new and may require more attention.
